batch: OLP-0174–0181 Beyond First-order Logic under the complete classical first-order profile
method: Fresh comparison of every exact frozen-English and Gujarati linguistic block, with independently worded reverse paraphrases for every substantive block. The review covers the definitions and formal distinctions in many-sorted, second-order, higher-order, intuitionistic and modal logic, the closing survey, and all six adjacent disclosed source repairs.
